zh-CN: 大项目详情查询减少重复读取，缩略图按可见区域加载并限制并发。
新增默认关闭的本机 MCP 接口，支持 AI 批量入库、查询、进度和相似项处理，并保留源文件。
同一原始位置、完整目录结构、文件名、文件数量和文件大小一致且快照完整时，可直接判定完全重复并跳过 MD5；自动跳过仍受用户设置控制，否则继续内容核验。
归档入库复用清单和目录信息，减少重复遍历与整库写回；队列运行期间可追加项目，并显示“等待下次入库”。
自动跳过保留项自动取消选择；更新窗口、窄窗口队列布局和 Windows 原生图标显示得到改善。
en-US: Large project details avoid repeated reads; thumbnails load near the visible area with bounded concurrency.
Added an opt-in local MCP interface for AI batch intake, queries, progress and similarity actions while keeping source files.

When the same original location, complete directory shape, filenames, file count and file sizes match a complete snapshot, a complete duplicate can skip MD5; automatic skipping remains controlled by the user's setting, otherwise content verification continues.
Archive intake reuses manifest and directory data to reduce repeated work; new items can be added during a queue run and show “Waiting for next intake run”.
Kept automatic-skip items are deselected automatically; the update dialog, narrow queue layout and Windows native icon rendering are improved.
